fields.climate: mild temperate; cool, cloudy, wet winters; hot, clear, dry summers; interior is cooler and wetter
fields.terrain: mostly mountains and hills; small plains along coast
fields.hazards: destructive earthquakes; tsunamis occur along southwestern coast; floods; drought
fields.resources: petroleum, natural gas, coal, bauxite, chromite, copper, iron ore, nickel, salt, timber, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: milk, maize, tomatoes, watermelons, potatoes, wheat, grapes, onions, cucumbers/gherkins, olives
fields.exports: garments, footwear, electricity, crude petroleum, iron alloys
fields.industries: food; footwear, apparel and clothing; lumber, oil, cement, chemicals, mining, basic metals, hydropower
fields.languages: Albanian 98.8% (official - derived from Tosk dialect), Greek 0.5%, other 0.6% (including Macedonian, Romani, Vlach, Turkish, Italian, and Serbo-Croatian), unspecified 0.1%
fields.religions: Muslim 56.7%, Roman Catholic 10%, Orthodox 6.8%, atheist 2.5%, Bektashi (a Sufi order) 2.1%, other 5.7%, unspecified 16.2%
fields.legal: civil law system except in the northern rural areas where customary law known as the "Code of Leke" is still present
fields.military: 18-30 for voluntary military service for men and women; conscription abolished 2010
